jobs.title: Project Manager - Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Adaptfy is growing! We are looking for a Project Management Associate with 5+ years of experience, to join our Data and Analytics team in Amsterdam.


Who we are

Adaptfy is a turnkey data & analytics solution for the SHV family of companies. We support multiple SHV Groups with advanced Data & Analytics in all areas, elevating their operations in diverse industries across international markets and throughout entire value chains.

Adaptfy is a joint venture formed by SHV and Metyis. Metyis embodies visionary thinking in the digital world, while SHV is a globally established family of companies built on the values of integrity, trust, curiosity, passion, and inclusivity.

 SHV has a presence across four continents, with businesses spanning energy, heavy lifting and transport, animal nutrition & aquaculture, testing, inspection & certification, and more. The organisation’s history reflects its courage to care—for people, for performance, and for future generations. Their success is a testament to constant reinvention through innovation.

 At Adaptfy, we play a pivotal role in bringing SHV’s digital vision to life. From optimising supply chains across Europe to enhancing operational efficiency in South America, we connect the dots for SHV, shaping a data-driven future for the entire family of companies.

What we offer

  • Opportunity to accelerate digital growth and business transformation through AI, Data & Analytics, Digital Commerce, advanced technologies, and strategic business solutions.

  • Driving high-impact insights & enhancing decision making across the organization.

  • Driving brand equity and digital sales through enhanced digital experiences.

  • Interaction with senior business (and/or ecommerce) leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.

  • Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team

     

What you will do

  • Support the successful delivery of client engagements across Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, and Business Transformation initiatives.

  • Manage assigned workstreams or smaller projects, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality, and budget.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), status reports, and project documentation.

  • Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks and dependencies, and proactively escalate issues where required.

  • Coordinate project activities across multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective execution and delivery.

  • Build strong working relationships with client stakeholders, project teams, and internal delivery functions.

  • Support governance activities including project reporting, steering committee preparation, action tracking, and decision management.

  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, sprint ceremonies, and status reviews.

  • Ensure clear communication of project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support change management and business readiness activities throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Business Technology consultants, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineers, Designers, and client stakeholders to coordinate successful delivery.

  • Contribute to Agile delivery by supporting sprint planning, backlog reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and dependency management.

  • Ensure project deliverables comply with agreed governance, quality standards, and delivery methodologies.

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, project governance, and team collaboration.

  • Support proposal development, project planning activities, and internal capability initiatives where required.

  • Travel as required to support client engagements.

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Delivery Management, Consulting, Digital Transformation, Technology Delivery, or related roles.

  • Experience supporting or managing projects within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business and technology functions.

  • Good understanding of Project Management principles including planning, governance, scheduling, RAID management, dependency management, budgeting, and reporting.

  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, delivery dashboards, and governance artefacts.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

  • Understanding of project lifecycle management from initiation through delivery and project closure.

  • Understanding of Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Technology initiatives.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Good analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working collaboratively within cross-functional consulting and delivery teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare project reports and executive-ready updates.

  • Experience facilitating project meetings, workshops, and delivery governance sessions.

  • Comfortable working with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and client leadership.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • Willingness to travel based on client and project requirements.

  • Experience delivering Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, Digital Commerce, Data & AI, Cloud, ERP, CRM, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Platform programmes.

  • Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

  • Experience using project delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Confluence, Planner, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or similar collaboration platforms.

  • Foundation certifications in Project Management (PRINCE2 Foundation, PMP, CAPM), Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Change Management.

  • Awareness of PMO governance, financial tracking, resource planning, and portfolio reporting.

  • Knowledge of Dutch or additional European languages is advantageous depending on client engagements.

We are united by our differences

At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). We do not use WhatsApp, social media messaging platforms, or personal accounts for recruitment outreach. If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Investing (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As a Product Manager in the Investing domain, you will contribute to the product scope our largest partners depend on, as well as our side of the joint dwpbank x lemon.markets suite. Your remit will include working with some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe to deliver core capabilities. These include trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the investing capabilities we're building jointly with dwpbank. You will scope them, prioritise them, and deliver them.

Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Investing, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work across internal teams at lemon.markets, our largest partners, and dwpbank counterparts in the group. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for a set of partner-critical Investing capabilities, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional crew including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, external partners, and colleagues in risk, finance, and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs internally and externally.

  • Ensure that any partner-specific integrations have longevity within our platform.

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects - scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise.

  • Work with dwpbank counterparts on joint product opportunities, translating between two organisations with different ways of working.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off fixes for the loudest partner.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in our space, and bring the insights back to the team.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 2-3 years of product experience, independently shipping highly complex products.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity - you can define a problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone else to hand you a spec.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You can express yourself in writing. Documentation, decisions, specs, partner comms - clear writing is a core part of the job.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable pushing what they can do.

  • You are professionally fluent in English and German.

  • Experience in regulated fintech / brokerage or B2B environments is a plus!

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Context
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Product Manager on the Context team, you will define and build the foundation for how AI agents access, interact with, and leverage context, data, tools, platforms, and environments, to deliver powerful, scalable solutions. This role exists to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world usability, ensuring our agents are both capable and seamlessly integrated into Mistral’s broader product ecosystem.

You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, research, design, and business, aligning stakeholders around a shared vision while driving execution from concept to launch. The impact of your work will shape how users and enterprises interact with AI, unlocking new possibilities for automation, intelligence, and efficiency.

What You Will Do

  • Define and evangelize a clear product strategy for our Context & Search platform, aligning it with company goals and market opportunities.

  • Lead market and UX research to identify unmet needs, competitive gaps, and emerging trends in enterprise AI.

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, balancing speed, quality, and user-centric design.

  • Collaborate with design and research teams to create intuitive, high-impact user experiences, iteratively refined by data and feedback.

  • Drive go-to-market efforts, including pricing, positioning, and adoption strategies, in partnership with marketing and sales.

  • Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines to ensure seamless execution.

  • Maintain a dynamic roadmap that delivers quick wins while advancing long-term strategic bets.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably with a focus on Agentic AI, Context Engineering, Data platforms, MCP/Connectors, Search, Ontology and semantic layers in B2B/Enterprise environments.

  • Strong technical fluency to navigate trade-offs and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

  • A relentless focus on solving real user problems, backed by data and qualitative insights.

  • Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams—engineering, design, and go-to-market—without direct authority.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for executives, teams, and users.

  • Adaptability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift rapidly.

  • Low ego, high EQ, and a collaborative mindset to build trust and drive decisions through clarity.

  • A builder’s mindset, with experience turning 0→1 ideas into products users love, and the autonomy to own outcomes end-to-end.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Product Manager Mission Payload Land (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join Quantum-Systems and drive mission-critical payload capabilities to make a real impact. As Product Manager Mission Payload Land, you own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for payload capabilities across our Land Domain Vehicle Portfolio. 

You operate at the intersection of customer value, technical feasibility, and commercial viability; working in tight collaboration with payload providers and internal engineering teams. You balance tactical mission requirements against platform constraints, make build-or-buy trade-offs consciously, and define high-value ConOps and payload configurations that the organization can execute against. 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • End-to-End Product Management: Own the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management for mission payload integration across the UGV portfolio from discovery and concept validation to operational deployment  

  • Market Screening & Ecosystem Management: Screen the market to identify, evaluate, and stand up partnerships with payload vendors across the domains ISR, Electronic Warfare, Communications, Combat Engineering, Logistics, and more 

  • Continuous Discovery & Experimentation: Drive prototyping and experimental integration of partner payloads including mechanical, E/E, and software integration interfaces and assess performance and usability 

  • Build-or-Buy & Productization: Prioritize payload capabilities based on mission utility and drive formal build-or-buy decisions for high-value use cases 

  • Engineering & Vendor Collaboration: Serve as the functional bridge between external payload suppliers, customer stakeholders, and internal engineering teams  

  • Iterative Delivery: Consolidate customer, user, and field operational insights to set product priorities and continuously convert requirements into shipped capabilities 



What you bring to the team:

  • Multiple years of hands-on experience in technical product/project management or systems engineering, ideally at a Tier-1 Defence Electronics, C4ISR, or Sensor Subsystem OEM 

  • Strong commercial instincts paired with a solid technical foundation, enabling you to liaise seamlessly between engineering teams and external customer stakeholders 

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach with a proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment 

  • Fluency in English to effectively engage with our global team and international customers; German is a plus 


Why Quantum-Systems:

About us

We are experts in building central cloud platforms, cloud risk mitigation and cloud operating models, providing thought leadership to central government and private enterprise organisations to help them unlock the true value of cloud.

By joining us, you'll accelerate your personal and professional development through hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud solutions. You'll learn directly from experts while contributing to some of the UK's most ambitious cloud programmes, gaining exposure and influence you wouldn't find in a larger consultancy.

 

About the role

Cloudscaler is growing. We are winning more cloud engagements across public and private sector, and we need delivery professionals who can take ownership of engagements and see them through. This role exists to make sure our client work is delivered on time, within scope, and to the standard that has built our reputation. You will report to the Chief Delivery Officer and work alongside Lead and Senior Delivery Managers across Cloudscaler’s client portfolio.

The role is client-facing and hands-on. It suits someone who has already delivered a complex technology programme end to end and wants to grow their consulting and stakeholder skills in a supportive team.

  • Experience working in or running agile delivery teams (Scrum, Kanban or hybrid).

  • Understanding of cloud migration approaches and the delivery challenges involved in moving and modernising workloads.

  • Some exposure to pre-sales, estimation or scoping work.

jobs.title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
jobs.description:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric


Hier starten jouw kansen  
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. 

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of 

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. 
 
C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. 

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client.
 
- Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client.
- Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…).
- Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème.
- Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints.
- Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions.
- Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks.
- Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives).
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning.
 
- Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité.
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
- Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client.
- Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet.
- Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance.
- Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins.
- Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
Report to: CEO

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

• (Really) flexible working hours, with a hybrid setup around our Delft office.

• Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with technology that matters.

• Real ownership, fast iteration, and tight feedback loops, and the chance to see what you build deployed in environments where it genuinely counts.

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, LinkedIn, or other source, as long as we get a clear picture of your background and track record.

• We'll get back to you as soon as possible. If we see a potential fit, we'll set up an initial conversation, followed by deeper sessions with the founders and the team where we work through real product scenarios together.

• If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

• Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Head of Electronics & software
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company.

This includes:

  • Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

  • Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

  • Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

  • Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

  • Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

  • Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk.

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

  • Electronics and PCB design

  • Harness CAD

  • Software development, build and configuration toolchains

  • Automated testing

  • GNC analysis and modelling

  • Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

  • Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale.

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

  • Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

  • Support major technical and engineering reviews

  • Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

  • Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

  • Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

  • Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

  • Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

  • Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

  • Headcount and personnel planning

  • Engineering tools and licences

  • Relevant shared simulation and test capability

  • Training and development

  • Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership.

You should bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

  • Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

  • Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

  • Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

  • Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

  • Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

  • Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

  • The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

  • Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

  • Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

  • Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

  • Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

  • Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

  • Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

  • Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

  • Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles

  • Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

jobs.description:
Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

Standplaats
Zoetermeer of Breda

Associate Principal/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice) - m/w/d
Technischer Senior ManagerIn Datenmigrationen & Schnittstellen, Digitalisierung DACH 100% (a)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest nicht nur die Kunden kompetent bez. der Implementierung unserer Fachsoftware CareOffice beraten, sondern auch die entsprechenden Lösungskonzepte erstellen, umsetzen und diese implementieren?

Deine Passion ist Kunden mit praxistauglichen Prozessen und der Parametrisierung von CareOffice zu beraten und diese in mittleren und grösseren Unternehmen einzuführen, wofür du gerne die Verantwortung übernimmst? Dann ist diese Rolle wie für dich gemacht.

Sogema Software ist ein führender Schweizer Anbieter für smarte Softwarelösungen im Enterprise Asset, Facility-, und Immobilien Management. Wir verbinden Technik, Wirtschaft und IT zu ganzheitlichen, praxisnahen Lösungen für unsere Kunden in Industrie, öffentlichen Institutionen und Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams aufgrund des weiteren Wachstums, in der Schweiz oder Deutschland, suchen wir eine/n

Technischer Senior ManagerIn Datenmigrationen & Schnittstellen, Digitalisierung DACH 100% (a) und Stv. CTO

Aufgaben

Über die Rolle

In dieser Position übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in Digitalisierungsprojekten entlang des gesamten Solution Lifecycles, von der Business Analyse über das Lösungskonzept bis hin zur technischen Implementierung, Integration, dem Betrieb und Support. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden, internen Spezialisten sowie cross-funktionalen Teams und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen, Geschäftsprozesse und Systemlandschaften.

Projekt- und Kundenarbeit

  • Du leitest Digitalisierungs- und Implementierungsprojekte von A–Z (EAM, CAFM, REM, Software-Einführungen und Transformationen), inklusive Anforderungsanalyse, Lösungskonzeption, technisches Konzept, Abnahme sowie Steuerung von Scope, Zeit, Budget, Risiken und Kommunikation

  • Du begleitest den kompletten Lifecycle: Business-Anforderungen, Solution Design, Implementierung, Integrations- und Systemtests, Abnahme, Dokumentation, Rollout, Hyper Care, Betrieb und 2nd-Level-Support

  • Du moderierst Workshops und Schulungen in Deutsch und wenn möglich auf Französisch, praxisnah, strukturiert und zielgruppenspezifisch für die IT-Abteilungen unserer Kunden

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche Implementierungsberatungen, -koordination und Schulungen von Kunden bzw. deren IT-Abteilungen (nicht der fachliche, sondern nur der IT-Teil)

  • Du unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Systemnutzung, Prozesse, Architektur und Workflows

  • Du freust dich auf eine Kombination von im Homeoffice und dem Vorort Einsatz beim Kunden in der DACH-Region

Business Analyse & Requirements Engineering

  • Du erhebst und analysierst Quelldaten (aus Excel, CSV, SQL oder ähnlichen Systemen) Geschäftsprozesse und leitest daraus IT- und System- sowie Schnittstellenanforderungen ab

  • Du führst Anforderungserhebung und Lösungsfindung eigenständig und im Team durch

  • Du bereitest die Datenmigration so vor, mit einem Mapping auf CareOffice, dass die Daten importiert werden können (erhältst z.B. 13 verschiedene Excelfiles vom Kunden) und kontrollierst die Datenqualität

  • Du erstellst die Schnittstellenspezifikationen (meistens für SAP, Abacus bzw. ERP-Systeme, REST API's, CSV, SML oder ähnliche) sowie Testfälle und merzt Abweichungen und Fehler aus. Nach interner Abnahme koordinierst du die Kundentest und die Freigabe in den Produktivbetrieb

  • Du erstellst adressatengerechte, klare und vollständige Dokumentation (Anforderungen, Betriebshandbuch, Sicherheitskonzept, User Guidelines)

Technische Umsetzung & Systemintegration

  • Du implementierst unsere Software CareOffice und Schnittstellen (REST API)

  • Du entwickelst Workflows, um Abläufe zu automatisieren

  • Du analysierst Daten, erstellst Datenmigrationskonzepte und setzt diese strukturiert um

  • Du analysierst Störungen (Incident- und Problem Management), unterstützt den Kunden kompetent und verantwortest nachhaltige Lösungen

Interne Zusammenarbeit

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem CTO, Head of Software Development, Product Owner, den nationalen und internationalen Projektleitern, Beratern, Software Entwicklern sowie dem Vertrieb zusammen.

  • Du gestaltest unser Unternehmen aktiv mit; Weiterentwicklung von Produkten, Methoden, Prozessen und Teamkompetenzen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium Bachelor oder Master in Informatik, z.B. Software Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller IT-, Digitalisierungs- oder Software-Implementierungsprojekte, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung über den gesamten Solution Lifecycle, von Business Analyse und Requirements Engineering über Solution Design und Implementierung bis zu Testing, Rollout, Hyper Care und Betrieb

  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung in Business Analyse und Requirements Engineering sowie die Fähigkeit, Geschäftsanforderungen in klare technische Anforderungen, Lösungskonzepte und Spezifikationen zu übersetzen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Datenmigration sowie praktische Erfahrung mit der Aufbereitung, Bereinigung, Validierung und dem Mapping heterogener Quelldaten, beispielsweise aus Excel-, CSV- und SQL-basierten Systemen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Systemintegrationen und Schnittstellen, insbesondere REST APIs sowie idealerweise Integrationen mit ERP-Systemen wie SAP oder Abacus und dateibasierten Schnittstellen

  • Gutes Verständnis von Datenbanken und sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, Datenstrukturen, Datenqualität und technische Zusammenhänge selbstständig zu analysieren sowie mit SQL-Befehlen zu bearbeiten

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung technischer Schnittstellenspezifikationen, Datenmappings und Testfälle sowie in der Durchführung und Koordination von Integrations-, System- und Abnahmetests

  • Technisches Verständnis für Softwareinstallationen, Systemkonfigurationen und Applikationsbetrieb und die Bereitschaft, CareOffice und zugehörige Schnittstellen auch selbstständig zu implementieren und zu konfigurieren

  • Erfahrung im Incident- und Problem Management sowie eine strukturierte Vorgehensweise bei der Analyse komplexer technischer Störungen und deren nachhaltiger Behebung

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung professioneller technischer Dokumentationen, beispielsweise Anforderungen, Schnittstellendokumentationen, Betriebshandbücher, Sicherheitskonzepte und User Guidelines

  • Ausgeprägte Projektmanagementkompetenz mit sicherem Umgang mit Scope, Terminen, Budget, Ressourcen, Risiken, Qualität, Stakeholdern und Eskalationen; eine anerkannte Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA C, PMI/PMP, PRINCE2) ist von Vorteil

  • Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und deren IT-Abteilungen sowie Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Moderation von Workshops, technischen Meetings und Schulungen

  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte rasch zu erfassen, zu strukturieren und eigenständig in umsetzbare Lösungen zu überführen

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Hands-on-Mentalität: Du koordinierst nicht nur, sondern arbeitest fachlich und technisch tagtäglich aktiv mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C2) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse für die regelmässige Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kollegen werden benötigt, Französischkenntnisse sind ein grosses Plus

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kundeneinsätzen innerhalb der DACH-Region in Kombination mit Homeoffice und der Zusammenarbeit mit unseren nationalen und internationalen Teams

Benefits

  • Ein vielseitiger Job in der Digitalisierung mit viel Gestaltungsfreiraum und Zusammenarbeit mit bekannten Kunden

  • Eigenständiges Aufgabengebiet, welches viel Gestaltungsmöglichkeit zulässt, gleitende Arbeitszeiten sowie Homeoffice sehr oft möglich macht

  • Ein kollegiales und internationales Team, das dein Wissen schätzt und eng zusammenarbeitet, ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, welches dich bei deiner Weiterentwicklung unterstützt

  • Branchenübliche Entlohnung und überdurchschnittliche Sozialversicherungsleistungen (BVG wird mehr einbezahlt, KTG, UVG/NBU werden vom Arbeitgeber übernommen

  • Unterjährig und jährlich einen mehrtätigen Firmenevent mit allen Kollegen von überall, irgendwo in Europa

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie eine moderne Remote- und Projektarbeitskultur

  • Eine Firma die nachhaltig aufgebaut ist und sich in einem grossen Wachstumsmarkt und -kurs befindet, was für unsere Mitarbeitende viele Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet in Zukunft

Du willst nicht nur Zaungast der Digitalisierung sein, sondern diese mittendrin mit Branchenführern der Instandhaltung, Facility und Real Estate Management vorantreiben?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Für diese Position werden nur Direktbewerbungen akzeptiert.

(a) Wir wenden uns an alle. Wir leben Diversität, lieben international und sind gegen jegliche Diskriminierung.

jobs.title: Senior QA Specialist
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

jobs.description:

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.
