jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Benelux
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the Benelux market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in Benelux: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in Benelux. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the Benelux market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in Benelux, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the Benelux market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent Dutch are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the Benelux market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

jobs.title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren ontwikkelaar en leider die graag de technische richting bepaalt én zelf aan de knoppen zit? Als Tech Lead bouw jij samen met het team van ontwikkelaars aan schaalbare cloudoplossingen waarmee dagelijks honderden organisaties slimmer en efficiënter werken. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Jouw keuzes hebben directe impact op techniek, product én de toekomst van digitale documentverwerking.

Jij maakt het mogelijk

Onze groei vraagt om robuuste, veilige en altijd beschikbare services. Als Tech Lead merk je direct waar risico’s ontstaan: complexiteit loopt op, schaalbaarheid komt in gevaar en technische schuld vraagt om leiderschap. Jij stuurt bij vóórdat klanten het merken. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst.

Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Je bent de kartrekker van de groep, en schakelt laagdrempelig met onze product owners, engineering manager en andere development teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat jij:

+ Leiding neemt over het low-code platform ontwikkelteam;

+ Samen met dit team ontwikkelt aan ons low-code platform, op basis van wensen vanuit de operatie én technische eisen voor future-proofing;

+ Als senior de codekwaliteit verhoogt door coaching, code-reviews en kennisdeling;

+ Actief meebouwt aan architectuurkeuzes, coding standards en automatisering in uitrol;

+ Kwaliteit borgt via tests, monitoring en goede documentatie;

+ Continu zoekt naar verbeteringen m.b.t. schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit, performance, security;

+ Samen met collega’s zoals ontwikkelaars, product owners en engineering managers spart over oplossingsrichtingen;

+ Wanneer nodig onze collega’s van consultancy en support helpt om complexe problemen met ons low-code platform op te lossen;

+ Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht.

Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet

Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

"Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).



Jij hebt het

+ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol;

+ Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen;

+ Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s;

+ Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen;

+ Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau;

+ Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen;

+ Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré;

+ Ervaring met low-code is een pré.

Ook breng je mee:

+ Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security;

+ Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team;

jobs.title: Implementation lead
jobs.description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused problem solver to join our Implementation team. You’ll lead end-to-end deployments of Watershed for our largest and most complex strategic accounts - translating goals into clear plans, finding solutions to customer needs, orchestrating cross-functional work, and building customer confidence.

You’ll design scalable systems and processes for repeatability while also solving complex, bespoke needs for our largest customers. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, advisory, customer success, and external partners to keep momentum high and outcomes measurable. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

 

You will:

  • Own and deliver implementations from kickoff to wrap-up: run discovery, map milestones, manage risks, and drive crisp execution

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact during implementations, building high‑trust relationships across technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Design out-of-the-box, creative solutions that meet customer needs, leveraging existing product and services and generating insight into potential future needs

  • Develop a deep understanding of Watershed’s product and services to guide customers on what’s possible and make smart trade‑offs

  • Conduct enablements for customers on using complex Watershed features

  • Coordinate internal and customer teams, sequence dependencies, and renegotiate timelines when inputs change

  • Act as the voice of the customer to product and engineering, surfacing patterns, blockers, and feature requests that inform the roadmap

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and processes that make implementations faster, more consistent, and measurable over time

 

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 3-6+ years in management consulting, solutions, or software implementation, preferably at a B2B SaaS company. You have experience leading customers through complex programs or projects

  • Take pride in your ability to learn new concepts quickly and thrive operating in a high-volume environment

  • Love to sweat the details, but are also able to zoom-out and see the big picture

  • Are a systems thinker who brings structure, clarity, and momentum to ambiguous problems

  • Are excellent at communicating clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences to introduce new concepts and drive alignment

  • Love working on multiple workstreams simultaneously, juggling multiple balls and keeping stakeholders accountable

  • Have a keen eye for identifying risks and drive mitigation plans to keep projects on track

  • Are an early adopter of AI solutions and excited to use them to drive impact

 

This position is required to be in person in our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
360Learning is entering its next phase of growth. Today, more than 2,500 organizations worldwide rely on us to turn internal expertise into business performance. As AI reshapes how companies develop skills and share knowledge, we are bringing together Collaborative Learning, AI and enterprise-grade infrastructure to redefine the future of L&D.

We are now looking for a Chief Financial Officer / VP Finance to help lead this next chapter.

Reporting directly to Benjamin Marchal, our CEO, you will lead our global Finance organization and act as a strategic partner to the CEO, Executive Committee and Board.

Your mission: drive sustainable, profitable growth while strengthening financial discipline, operational performance and long-term value creation. You will help shape our SaaS operating model, optimize resource allocation and balance growth, profitability and cash generation.

Working closely with leaders across Revenue, Product, People and Operations, you will turn financial insights into business decisions, foster accountability and support our strategic priorities, including M&A, investor relations and future liquidity events.

We are looking for a Finance leader who combines strategic vision, strong business judgment and hands-on execution. Whether you are an experienced CFO or a VP Finance ready to step up, this is an opportunity to work directly with the CEO and Board and shape some of the company's most consequential decisions.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Understand 360Learning's strategy, financial performance, organization, culture and key business priorities.

  • Build strong relationships with the CEO, Executive Committee, Finance team and key internal stakeholders.

  • Review our financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting and performance management processes.

  • Assess the maturity of our Finance organization, systems, internal controls and financial governance.

  • Identify the main drivers of growth, profitability, cash generation and operational efficiency.

  • Deliver an initial diagnostic highlighting key risks, opportunities and short-term priorities.


Within 3 months, you will:

  • Build and align with the CEO on an 18-month Finance roadmap, covering financial performance, operational efficiency, systems, processes, governance and team development.

  • Strengthen financial visibility through accurate forecasting, clear SaaS metrics and actionable management reporting.

  • Establish a strong financial business partnering approach with Revenue, Product, People and other functions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, productivity and resource allocation while protecting strategic investments.

  • Review our financial systems and data infrastructure, identifying automation and scalability opportunities.

  • Take ownership of Board reporting, investor communications and financial planning processes.

  • Assess our current M&A framework and identify opportunities to strengthen due diligence and post-acquisition performance tracking.


Within 12 months, you will:

  • Drive measurable progress towards our growth and profitability ambitions, improving financial efficiency, cash generation and Rule of 40 performance.

  • Establish a best-in-class financial operating model, with reliable forecasts, transparent KPIs and clear accountability across functions.

  • Lead strategic financial initiatives to optimize our cost structure, improve unit economics and support sustainable ARR growth.

  • Build a high-performing, scalable global Finance organization combining strategic business partnering with strong operational execution.

  • Strengthen financial governance, compliance, audit readiness and risk management across our international entities.

  • Support the evaluation, execution and financial integration of strategic acquisitions.

  • Partner with the CEO and Board on long-term financial strategy, capital structure and potential future fundraising or liquidity scenarios.

  • Make Finance a key driver of business performance and shareholder value creation.


The Skill Set:

  • 10+ years in Finance, including senior leadership in B2B SaaS, ideally scaling from €30–50M to €100M+ ARR.

  • Strong grasp of ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, gross margin, retention and Rule of 40.

  • Expertise in forecasting, financial modeling, performance management and data-driven decision-making.

  • Ability to balance growth investments, profitability, cash generation and operational efficiency.

  • Trusted advisor to the CEO and Executive Committee, able to challenge assumptions and drive accountability.

  • Experience with PE/Growth Equity investors, Board reporting, financial governance and capital allocation.

  • Exposure to M&A, due diligence, fundraising and capital structure; transaction leadership is a plus.

  • Strong command of accounting, reporting, treasury, cash management, compliance and internal controls.

  • Track record of building high-performing teams, automating processes and scaling international Finance operations.

  • Hands-on, pragmatic and accountable, aligned with Convexity’s values of Impact, Rational Thinking, High Accountability and Scalability. Fluent English; French is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

Interview Process:

With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.






Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position, but we're prioritising candidates from EMEA. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
Chief Customer Officer
jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position 
Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. 

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The mandate

  1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
    You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
  2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
    You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
  3. Win the right members, efficiently.
    You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
  4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
    Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
  5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
    You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
  6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
    Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
  7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
    You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

  • You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
  • You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
  • You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
  • You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
  • You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What you'll have done 

  • 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
  • Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
  • Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
  • Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
  • Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
  • Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
  • A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

 

The first 90 days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.
Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.
Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What this role is not

  • Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
  • Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
  • Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
  • Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balance
    Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. 

  • Expect Excellence
    Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst with a strong background in financial services and exchange trading. In this role, you will contribute to the analysis and delivery of sophisticated trading capabilities, working at the intersection of business requirements, financial markets and technology.

You will collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders, including business representatives, product managers, architects, developers and testing specialists, translating complex market and business needs into precise, implementation-ready specifications.

Contract: Personal Lease / Contractor

Contract Duration: 12 months

Location: Zürich, Switzerland

Work Model: Hybrid – 50% remote

Responsibilities:

  • Analyse and structure complex business requirements within financial markets, exchange trading and market infrastructure

  • Translate business and operational needs into detailed functional and technical specifications

  • Analyse the functionality of trading platforms and matching engines, including order processing, execution flows and trading lifecycle processes

  • Define and document requirements related to different market models and exchange-traded financial instruments

  • Prepare comprehensive business requirements, functional specifications and interface specifications

  • Evaluate the impact of new requirements and changes across interconnected systems, processes and interfaces

  • Work closely with product management, business stakeholders, solution architects, developers and QA teams throughout the delivery lifecycle

  • Support backlog refinement, feature definition, implementation planning and delivery within an Agile environment

  • Ensure requirements are sufficiently detailed, consistent and actionable for development and testing

  • Contribute to the analysis of topics related to trading, market data, reference data and regulatory requirements


  • 7+ years of professional experience in financial services, ideally with a significant focus on requirements engineering or business analysis

  • 4–6 years of experience with exchange-traded financial products, with strong expertise in:

  • Fixed Income

  • Structured Products

  • Experience with Equities and ETFs is an advantage

  • Excellent understanding of trading platforms and matching engines

  • Strong knowledge of order handling and order management, trade execution workflows, market models, trading lifecycle processes

  • Proven ability to analyse and specify complex trading functionality across multiple systems

  • Experience assessing business, operational and technical dependencies and impacts

  • Strong track record in creating business requirements, functional specifications, interface specifications and implementation-ready documentation

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a high level of attention to detail

  • Understanding of market data, reference data and relevant regulatory considerations

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments

  • Fluent written and spoken English

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack-Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns:

Du möchtest moderne Softwarelösungen entwickeln und dabei sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend aktiv mitwirken? Du interessierst Dich für skalierbare Systemarchitekturen, innovative Technologien und die Zusammenarbeit in agilen Teams? Dann bist Du bei TecFox genau richtig!

Wir, die TecFox GmbH, sind ein zukunftsorientiertes IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit Wurzeln in der Region Braunschweig/Wolfsburg. Wir realisieren bundesweit IT-Projekte für namhafte Unternehmen aus verschiedensten Branchen. Mit unserem Know-how und unserer langjährigen Erfahrung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Lösungen. Bei TecFox erwarten Dich spannende, anspruchsvolle und technisch herausfordernde Projekte in einem angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld.

Deine Aufgaben bei uns:

Als Fullstack-Entwickler:in bist Du an der ganzheitlichen Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen beteiligt – von der ersten Konzeption bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen:

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit an größeren Entwicklungsprojekten innerhalb agiler Teams

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Beratung und Unterstützung von Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen bei komplexen Entwicklungsaufgaben

  • Freude daran, als technische Ansprechperson für anspruchsvolle Architektur-, Entwicklungs- und Integrationsfragen zu fungieren und Frontend- sowie Backend-Teams fachlich bei der Umsetzung komplexer Softwarelösungen zu begleiten

  • Ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Arbeit und die entwickelten Softwarelösungen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens Niveau C1) sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
We're proud to be ranked as the 12th fastest growing startup on the Sifted 250 list! 🚀

👉Read about it here

About Kota

Kota is the only broker that runs employee benefits for you. Combining health cover, pensions, protection, spend cards, and flexible perks with HRIS integrations, Kota replaces spreadsheets, manual admin, and once-a-year broker calls with one connected system - backed by a team of benefits experts behind every recommendation.

Kota powers benefits for more than 100,000 employees, across companies from fast-growing scale-ups to global HR and payroll platforms.

Investors include Eurazeo, EQT Ventures, Northzone, Frontline Ventures, 9Yards, and Plug and Play Ventures. The Kota team includes experts who previously led at global financial services firms and fintechs such as Airwallex, Stripe, Bolt, Revolut - as well as insurance and benefits providers such as Aviva, Allianz, AXA, and Smart Pension.


The Role

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager in our Embed team to own and manage the relationship with our strategic customers. This role requires managing a portfolio of enterprise clients and acting as their strategic commercial partner: driving expansion across new countries, deepening stakeholder relationships, and surfacing insights that shape our product and operational priorities.

As we expand into new geographies and onboard more complex enterprise clients, we need someone who can drive growth, strengthen relationships, and make sure partners get the full value of Kota Embed.

You're joining at a moment of real momentum for Embed. New clients, markets and opportunities are coming online fast, which brings both challenge and the chance to make a genuine impact.


What You'll Do

  • Drive client growth: expand usage across new countries, product modules and eligible populations, and build clear account plans, forecasts and expansion roadmaps

  • Spot upsell and expansion triggers early, then coordinate internally to execute them

  • Own strategic relationships as the primary contact for post-launch Embed clients, building multi-level relationships across their Product, Ops and Commercial teams

  • Run structured QBRs that align stakeholders and drive long-term partnership value.

  • Own client-level escalations (not consumer queries), coordinating resolution across Product, Integrations, Expansion & Benefits, and Embed Operations, and keeping clients informed through issues or delays

  • Track account performance across revenue, lives, satisfaction and operational health, surfacing trends and risks early and turning them into clear action

  • Champion the voice of the client: distil feedback into insights for Product, Expansion and Ops, and help shape the Embed partnership model and lifecycle as we scale


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in account management, partnerships or customer success

  • Strong relationship builder, confident with senior stakeholders and delivering board level presentations

  • Experience of managing large complex renewals and multi year engagements

  • Crafting of complex propositions, straddling technical, commercial and support

  • Thrives in a dynamic, unstructured startup environment

  • Iterates and executes quickly - has built process and strategies in previous high growth organisations

  • Highly organised, thrives under pressure, able to manage multiple clients at pace

  • Experience of going from zero to one and building new commercial frameworks

  • Has sold and managed technical products previously - can quickly move between reading a balance sheet and technical API documentation

  • Prior experience in health insurance, benefits, EOR/GP or SaaS/Fintech is a big plus


Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won’t jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team’s standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm – now we do this everyday.


Kota Benefits

  • Attractive stock options to share in the success of Kota

  • Health Insurance

  • Life assurance (country dependent)

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
jobs.description:
About Our Client

Our client is a global IT consulting and digital engineering company specializing in software development, cloud transformation, data and AI, and digital experience solutions.

With an international presence and extensive engineering capabilities, the company supports enterprise clients across multiple industries in designing, developing, and implementing technology-driven business solutions.

Our client is expanding its Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) practice in the DACH region and is looking for a consultant with deep e-commerce knowledge, technical understanding, and client-facing advisory experience.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce, you will help grow our client's Retail & CPG business by translating business challenges into technology solutions and consulting engagements.

This is a hands-on functional consulting role with a strong technical and pre-sales component. You will work closely with senior client stakeholders, sales teams, and technical specialists to shape digital commerce solutions, lead discovery workshops, and support new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate understands how different e-commerce platforms and customer-facing technologies work together, can advise clients on the right solutions, and is comfortable collaborating with commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise Retail & CPG clients on e-commerce, digital customer experience, personalization, customer data and technology transformation.
  • Translate business requirements into solution concepts, capability roadmaps and target architectures.
  • Lead discovery sessions and solution design workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
  • Advise on the integration of commerce platforms, CDPs, marketing technologies, PIM, OMS and other digital commerce systems.
  • Collaborate with sales and pre-sales teams to identify client opportunities, develop proposals and shape consulting engagements.
  • Stay informed about DACH retail trends, marketplace dynamics, emerging technologies and changing customer expectations.
  • Develop reusable consulting assets, including reference architectures, solution frameworks, demonstrations and go-to-market offerings.
  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CDOs, CMOs, CIOs, and Heads of E-commerce.
  • Collaborate with regional and global technology teams to support the growth of the Retail & CPG practice.
  • Represent the company at client meetings, industry conferences, and relevant networking events.

Key Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the broader digital commerce ecosystem and how its different technologies connect.

Relevant areas include:

  • E-commerce platforms: commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce, Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, headless and composable commerce.
  • Customer data and CDPs: Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Segment, mParticle, Tealium, Bloomreach, first-party data and consent management.
  • Marketing technology and personalization: Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, Emarsys, Dynamic Yield, Algolia, Optimizely and customer journey optimization.
  • Commerce architecture and integrations: OMS, PIM, DAM, APIs, system integrations, distributed order management and omnichannel fulfillment.
  • Marketplaces and retail media: Amazon, Zalando, Otto, Kaufland, retail media networks, marketplace integrations and D2C business models.
  • Emerging commerce technologies: AI-assisted shopping, conversational commerce, GenAI applications, loyalty solutions and digital customer engagement.

Expertise across every platform is not required. What matters most is understanding how these technologies work together and recommending solutions that match clients' business needs.

Your Profile

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or digital commerce, ideally within Retail & CPG.
  • Background in IT consulting, digital transformation, systems integration, technology services, or digital commerce consulting.
  • Technical-functional understanding of e-commerce platforms, system integrations, data flows, and digital customer-facing solutions.
  • Experience working directly with clients, gathering requirements, leading workshops, and developing solution recommendations.
  • Familiarity with pre-sales processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with sales teams.
  • Understanding of the DACH retail and CPG market, including major retailers, marketplace dynamics, digital commerce trends, and GDPR requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex technology concepts to both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in German and English.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% across the region.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience within an IT service provider or digital engineering consultancy.
  • Experience in technical pre-sales, proposal development, RFPs, or solution shaping.
  • Existing relationships within the DACH Retail & CPG ecosystem.
  • Experience developing consulting offerings, reference architectures, or reusable technology accelerators.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, data analytics, AI, and custom application development.
  • Knowledge of retail media, marketplace integrations, pricing and promotion technologies, or loyalty solutions.

What Our Client Offers

  • A role combining technology consulting, digital commerce strategy and business development.
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to expanding a Retail & CPG consulting practice in DACH.
  • Collaboration with international engineering, architecture, and technology teams.
  • Exposure to enterprise retail and CPG clients and complex digital transformation projects.
  • Opportunities to shape new consulting offerings and contribute to business growth.
