jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

 

About the Team

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.

AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped.

For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end.

 

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar.
  • Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.
  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs.
  • Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt.
  • Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable.
  • Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability.
  • Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the services your teams run and step in as Incident Commander when needed.
  • Own your teams' delivery: set quarterly plans, track progress against the product roadmap and help shape department-wide planning and strategy.

 

What You Must Have

  • 3+ years of recent experience as an Engineering Manager leading software engineering teams, ideally in SaaS product companies.
  • A strong software engineering background, and you're still hands-on today. You can review code and designs credibly, dig into technical issues and contribute to architecture decisions.
  • Proven people leadership: hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management and helping engineers grow into their next role.
  • A strong product engineering mindset. You've partnered with Product and Design on discovery, worked directly with customers and measured success by customer and business outcomes rather than output.
  • Business acumen. You understand the commercial context, can explain trade-offs in terms of impact and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience using engineering metrics and flow practices (such as DORA metrics, cycle time or WIP limits) to find bottlenecks and improve delivery, quality and team health, without turning metrics into targets.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and agentic tools, both in your own work and across a team. You have a clear view of how AI changes delivery speed, code quality, review practices and cognitive load.
  • Experience planning and delivering complex initiatives across several teams predictably, including managing dependencies, risks and incidents.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

None of these are required, and we're happy to support you as you learn them on the job.

  • Experience in the localization industry or with translation workflows.
  • Experience leading engineering teams at a product company during a scale-up phase.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered product features, such as LLM-based features, to customers.
  • Experience managing fully remote, distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with developer experience or productivity frameworks, such as SPACE or DevEx.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget — for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget — monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great startup culture — remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

What You Will Do

This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.

What You Must Have

jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is growing rapidly, and we’re looking for a Lead Engineer, Maritime to take hands-on technical ownership of a maritime product and help turn operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll initially focus on one product, working across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams to solve the most important technical problems and take it from its current configuration to repeatable production and customer delivery.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, lead system-level trade-offs, investigate failures and make sure design changes are supported by test evidence and reflected in what we build.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong maritime engineering judgement with the ability to bring people together and deliver at pace. As UFORCE’s maritime portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Maritime, based on business need and demonstrated performance.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product’s technical baseline across hull, propulsion, power, onboard electronics, control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces and control systems.

  • Work with naval architecture and marine engineering specialists to maintain the stability, structural, weight and safety evidence supporting the product configuration.

  • Translate customer requirements, operator feedback and field experience into clear engineering priorities and an executable delivery plan.

  • Lead technical trade-offs and systems integration across mechanical, electrical, marine-control and software interfaces.

  • Work closely with Ukrainian product experts and international engineering teams to preserve operational knowledge and develop the product for Western customers.

  • Establish practical requirements, configuration and change control so engineering, manufacturing and field teams work from a consistent, approved design.

  • Lead failure investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective action, verifying fixes through repeatable bench, dockside and sea testing.

  • Demonstrate product performance and reliability through clear test plans, measured results and documented operating limits.

  • Partner with manufacturing and supply chain on design for manufacture, component qualification, approved substitutions, cost and production readiness.

  • Release the engineering package needed for repeatable production, including drawings, bills of materials, assembly requirements and acceptance tests.

  • Provide technical readiness assessments for customer trials and demonstrations, distinguishing proven capability from development goals.

  • Coordinate engineers and specialist partners, make ownership clear and escalate technical, safety or resource risks early.

  • Identify opportunities to reuse architecture, components and engineering practices as the maritime product range grows.

Required Skill

  • Experience personally leading engineering delivery for a complete uncrewed vessel or substantial integrated maritime product, with clear ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

  • Strong systems integration judgement across mechanical, electrical, propulsion, control, communications, navigation and software interfaces.

  • Experience taking a maritime product from prototype towards repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production test.

  • A track record of investigating sea-trial or field failures, identifying root causes and proving corrective actions through testing.

  • The ability to lead engineers across disciplines and drive delivery through influence as well as formal authority.

  • Practical understanding of how design decisions affect component availability, qualification, unit cost and manufacturing quality.

  • An understanding of how marine conditions, degraded navigation, communications resilience and operator feedback affect vessel design and testing.

  • The judgement to recognize stability, structural and vessel-safety implications and involve the appropriate technical specialists.

  • The ability to turn incomplete information into clear priorities, sound technical decisions and measurable progress.

  • Clear, honest communication about product capability, limitations, risks and delivery feasibility.

  • A hands-on approach, high ownership and the judgement to balance speed with appropriate engineering discipline.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, sea-trial sites and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian maritime teams, products or operators.

  • Experience adapting products for Western defence customers.

  • Familiarity with applicable defence sourcing restrictions and export-control requirements.

  • Experience supporting customer sea trials, military qualification, vessel classification or marine assurance activity.

  • Experience with naval architecture, high-speed craft, marine autonomy, USVs / UUVs or mission-payload integration.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across countries.

  • Evidence of growing from hands-on product ownership into broader technical leadership.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)

  • Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe

Process de recrutement

- Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

- Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h)

- Un entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min)

- Un Final Round avec Jacob, Head of Sales SMEs (30 min)

- Un Team Fit Interview avec les membres de l'équipe (45 min) - sur site

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

👪 Team and environment

As we keep on growing (+500 people joined Pennylane in 2025!), we're seeking an Application Security Engineer to join Louis's team of 5. You'll handle all technical security matters, support ISO 27001 compliance, and advise employees—especially developers—on security best practices.

The technical security team manages security issues from detection to resolution, collaborating with developers and Security Champions when needed.

🎯 Your tasks

Security by design : ensure the security of Pennylane’s application and infrastructure

  • Engage with Product Team to integrate security in our features from from the beginning, from design to delivery

  • Conducting code reviews from a secure development point of view (about 80 releases per day).

  • Detect vulnerability and propose associated patches

  • Raise the security level of our CI/CD configuration

  • With the DevOps team, secure our AWS infrastructure, including its Kubernetes environment (AWS EKS)

Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct and perform regular security assessments (internally or by an external consulting companies) on the applications (code reviews/pentests/bug bounty in particular) and the infrastructure

  • Strengthen the current means of detecting malicious attempts

  • Be involved in all security incidents, investigate logs, block attacks, and propose corrective measures to prevent future threats.

Compliance & awareness

  • Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 controls (processes) related to development (mandatory code practices, validation, patch management, vulnerability management, etc.) by training developers, monitoring projects (tech, product), conducting regular internal audits and managing tech non-conformities

  • Build/Improve secure development training materials and conduct regular training sessions with the developers. Engaging them in our Security Champions program

  • Improve the security awareness through the company

  • Contribute to tenders to explain our security policies and provide the necessary technical details

These missions are not exhaustive and remain evolving.

🥇You’re the right candidate if

You ideally have the following skills/experience:

  • Able to perform offensive security assessments on an infrastructure and an application

  • You know how to exploit and fix a wide range of Web vulnerabilities and are able to explain them to non-technical person (not just the OWASP top 10)

  • You already have an experience in a programming language (Ruby, Python, JavaScript), either for quick and dirty scripting to exploit a vulnerability or for larger projects

  • You have an experience in cloud infrastructure security

  • You are able to popularize technical terms to facilitate the adoption of security measures within projects or to broadcast messages to Pennylaners

  • You are fluent in French and/or English (both oral and written)

Your soft skills :

  • You are humble

  • You are a team player, and working with remote colleagues is not an issue for you

  • You are proactive and organized

  • You are a quick learner, and you like to work on different projects (application security, cloud infrastructure, training, ISO 27001…)

💬 What does the recruitment process look like ?

  • You will first have a general chat with Alexandre, Talent Acquisition (30min)

  • Then you’ll meet Louis, (AppSec Team Lead) and 1 team member for a technical interview (1h)

  • You carry out independently the technical challenge for the next 48h

  • Then, you’ll discuss about your solutions with Louis and another team member - (1h)

  • Finally, a last culture fit meeting with Guillaume, Head of Security (1h)

We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

jobs.title: Account Executive  - DACH
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in France: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in France. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the French market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in France, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the French market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent French are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the French market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

jobs.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

  • Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.

  • Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store).

  • Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues.

  • Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments.

  • Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance.

  • Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

  • Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve.

  • Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations.

  • Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction.


Essential skills

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

  • Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.).

  • Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS

  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

  • Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration.

  • Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Desirable skills

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech.

  • Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments.

  • Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS).

  • Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.


On a typical week

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences.

Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing.

After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks.

We offer

  • A revenue-generating role in a fast-growing scale-up company; 

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a satellite office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work at AIHR

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 4 Trust days per year (ad-hoc recovery days to take whenever you're overwhelmed, exhausted, or need to deal with something personal);

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!


Who you are

We're looking for an ambitious, data-driven, and commercially minded growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit. Someone who loves identifying opportunities, challenging existing approaches, and turning ideas into measurable results. You're not just a strategic thinker; you're equally excited about getting operational, executing ideas yourself, and making things happen.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling customer acquisition, ideally across both B2C and B2B businesses in SaaS, e-learning, or other high-growth industries;

  • Demonstrable experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns, including managing or scaling advertising budgets of €100,000+ per month;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive into performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable initiatives;

  • A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, including paid acquisition, CRO, landing page optimization, email marketing, and growth economics such as CAC and LTV;

  • Strong experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and reporting;

  • Experience identifying, testing, and scaling new acquisition channels and growth opportunities;

  • Strong AI proficiency, with experience using ChatGPT and Claude to analyze data, improve workflows, and accelerate execution;

  • An understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing customer acquisition, with a forward-thinking approach to emerging marketing channels;

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to independently lead and execute initiatives while collaborating effectively with the wider team;

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a hunger to grow;

  • Bonus: Experience in event marketing, community-led growth, or account-based marketing (ABM).

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our new Senior Growth Marketing Manager? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

 

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Experience/Release Engineering team in Berlin. You will own how code travels from a developer’s commit to millions of users across Superhuman’s products: Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Mail.

As our product suite grows, so do the number of engineers contributing to it and the number of surfaces we release on (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, APIs). Our team makes shipping fast, safe, and boring. The team builds and runs the CI/CD platform, release pipelines, and rollout tooling that let product teams deploy many times a day with confidence; it enables engineers to be productive, use new technologies to optimize the SLDC, and push on green many times a day.

You will lead a team of engineers working at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and reliability. You will partner with Product Engineering, SRE, Platform/Infrastructure, and Security to increase release speed and safety. This role is hands-on: you will help set the technical direction and stay close to the work.

As an Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers; hire great people and build a strong, inclusive team culture in Berlin and across a distributed organization.

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for CI/CD, build, and release systems that scale with company growth and the number of products and surfaces we ship.

  • Drive faster, safer delivery: improve lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore, and make these measures visible to engineering leadership.

  • Build and operate release tooling, including progressive rollouts, canaries, feature flags, automated rollback, and release health monitoring.

  • Coordinate release trains and launches across all our products, working with Product, QA, Support, and Marketing to ensure major launches land smoothly.

  • Partner with SRE, Infrastructure, and Security to keep the delivery platform reliable and compliant, including supply chain security, artifact integrity, and access controls.

  • Reduce friction for product engineers: cut build and test times, eliminate flaky tests and pipelines, and offer self-service paths so teams can ship without waiting on us.

  • Act as an escalation point and Incident Commander for release-related incidents, and lead blameless postmortems that turn into lasting fixes.

  • Balance near-term pipeline fixes with foundational investments, and make clear tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.

  • Stay hands-on where it matters: review designs, help debug tough pipeline problems, and set a high engineering bar.

 

Qualifications

  • Have 5+ years of software, DevOps, or release/build engineering experience, and 2+ years managing engineers (or engineering managers) with a record of hiring, developing, and retaining talent.

  • Bring hands-on depth in CI/CD systems and build tooling (for example, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Bazel, or similar) and can reason independently about pipeline architecture and trade-offs.

  • Know cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes or another container orchestration system.

  • Have shipped and operated release systems at scale, using progressive delivery, feature flags, canary releases, and safe rollback.

  • Understand release practices across multiple surfaces (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, or backend services).

  • Know infrastructure as code (eg Terraform) and observability tooling, and use delivery metrics (DORA) to guide decisions.

  • Have experience as an Incident Commander and running blameless postmortems.

  • Know the basics of software supply chain security: dependency management, artifact signing, and secrets handling.

  • Have experience managing people in a distributed or remote setting, and can collaborate effectively with Product, SRE, Security, QA, and Support.

  • Operate well in ambiguity, set a high engineering bar, and empower senior engineers to own technical decisions.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Director
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)
Senior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)
Deployment Strategist - SAP & ERP Specialist
jobs.description:
TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.
